# Generated code — do not edit

<!-- ORES-GENERATED-FREEZE: frozen -->

Everything in this directory is **derivative output**. It is produced by a generator from an upstream source of truth (TypeSpec and/or JSON Schema, an ORM schema, or a protocol definition), and it is regenerated wholesale.

**Any edit you make here will be silently destroyed the next time the generator runs.** If something in this directory is wrong, fix the generator or upstream authority instead.

## Freeze policy

This tree is tracked and intentionally classified as `frozen`. `scripts/lock-generated.sh` strips the write bit from generated files after checkout or regeneration so accidental edits fail loudly. Git does not preserve arbitrary read-only bits, so the tracked marker above is the durable VCS policy and the lock script supplies the working-tree enforcement.

## Regenerating

Run the owning generator, then run `scripts/lock-generated.sh`. Validate the generator/check task before committing regenerated outputs. Do not hand-edit generated artifacts between runs.
